not_started.text:
Welcome! Are you ready for a mission?

Have you seen the Gremlins around here? They've stolen the precious Blue Gemstone!

You must recover it from them!

Place your cursor over a Gremlin and attack. Complete this mission and I'll reward you with useful items. Good luck!

hunt_gremlin.text:
Did you forget what to do? Get a blue gem! You must kill Gremlins to get a blue gem.

Kill, kill, kill the Gremlins!

return_helper.text:
You got a blue gem! Right On!

As promised, here are Soulshots for beginners and a Recommendation. Take the Recommendation to Grand Master Roien — he's eager to meet you.

see_roien.text:
Speak with Grand Master Roien over there. He's eager to meet you. He has a gift for you.

May the goddess of luck be with you!

completed.text: You're doing well. Seek Darin in the village when you reach level 2 — he needs help with a letter.

need_reco.text:
Welcome. I am Grand Master Roien, of Sedrick's Training Hall.

Did you get the Recommendation from the Newbie Helper?

no_reco.text: Speak with the Newbie Helper first. Complete the Blue Gemstone task, then return with a Recommendation.

after.text:
You have learned the basic operations of the game well. From here on out, you will be able to really enjoy the adventure!

Take this gift. You may continue exploring Talking Island.

choices.label: I will adventure on Talking Island.

too_low.text: Come back when you're a bit more experienced (level 2). Love waits for no one — but I can.

available.text:
What's more dangerous than a Knight's sword or a Wizard's staff? That thing we call love!

I am in love with Roxxy. Will you help me?

cond_1.text: Please give Roxxy my letter. You'll find her near the village path. Hurry — my nerves can't stand the strain!

cond_2.text: She sent a handkerchief? Wonderful! Please take this receipt to Magister Baulro for the potion I ordered.

cond_3.text: Baulro should have the potion ready. Please hurry!

cond_4.text: You brought the potion? Thank you! Please accept this small gift — a Necklace of Knowledge — and my undying thanks!

done.text: Thanks to you, I finally found the courage to speak with Roxxy.

need_letter.text: A letter...for me? From Darin? Oh my — please give Darin my handkerchief as a pledge of my affection!

waiting.text: Please tell Darin not to waste any more time.

idle.text: Welcome to Talking Island. Safe travels.

need_receipt.text: Darin sent you, eh? Here's the "magic potion" he ordered. Take it to him — and not a word about the ingredients!

waiting.text: You've already got the potion. Don't keep Darin waiting.

idle.text: Magic and courage both require practice. Come back when Darin sends you.
